tools.name: search_book_places
tools.description: Use when asked for places behind a book or a map of them. Takes a book title and optional author; returns regions, estimated trip days, cities with countries, highlights, and a link to the book's map on mystoryland.ai.

tools.name: get_literary_route
tools.description: Use when asked for a book route, stops, or itinerary. Takes a book title with optional author and region, or a public mystoryland.ai/i/ link alone. Returns stops by city in order, book connections, and a link. If region choices are returned, ask the reader to choose one and call again.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Use when asked to plan a trip around a book. Takes days, pace, optional start, and a book title with optional author and region, or a public mystoryland.ai/i/ link. Returns a day-by-day plan of stops and a link. If region choices are returned, ask the reader to choose one and call again.
